what: The kill switch for the wall. Put a discussion number or a login in here, commit, and it is gone from sixfingers.vercel.app within the minute. No deploy, no password, nobody else needed.
it_can_only_hide: Nothing in this file can make text appear on anybody's screen. It only ever removes. That is deliberate: a file that could add would have to be guarded like a secret, and the worst a mistake in this one can do is empty the wall.
you_usually_do_not_need_it: GitHub's own moderation is faster and better: Hide as spam on a comment, or Delete on a discussion. The robot honours both. This file is for when you want something gone and you want it gone now, or when the same person keeps coming back.
how_to_use_it: hidden_discussions: the NUMBER at the end of the discussion URL. .../discussions/42 is 42.
hidden_logins: a GitHub username, without the @. Everything they wrote goes, posts and comments both.
Both lists may be empty. An empty file hides nothing, which is the normal state.
If this file is unreadable, the robot hides nothing and says so in its log. It never fails closed.
